name: shopify-store-extractor
description: Export public Shopify products, prices, SKUs, variants and availability; compare storefront snapshots. Optional published inventory, panels and recommendations cost extra. Missing inventory is unknown, not zero; report partial coverage.

interface.longDescription: Export public Shopify products, prices, SKUs, variants and availability; compare storefront snapshots. Optional published inventory, panels and recommendations cost extra. Missing inventory is unknown, not zero; report partial coverage. Connect your own Apify account through OAuth. Runs are billed to that account under the Actor’s current pricing; ChatGPT or Codex subscription fees do not include Apify charges.
defaultPrompt: Export 10 public products from allbirds.com, including variants, with a $0.02 spending limit.
